([[Hollywood, Florida]]) | college = * [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]] (2019–2021) * [[Dayton Flyers men's basketball|Dayton]] (2021–2023) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = * First-team All-[[Atlantic 10 Conference|Atlantic 10]] (2023) * Third-team All-Atlantic 10 (2022) * Atlantic 10 All-Defensive team (2023) }} '''Toumani Camara''' (born 8 May 2000) is a Belgian [[college basketball]] player for the [[Dayton Flyers men's basketball|Dayton Flyers]]. He moved to the United States to attend [[Chaminade-Madonna College Preparatory School]] in [[Hollywood, Florida]]. Camara previously played for the [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia Bulldogs]] during his first two collegiate seasons. ==Early life== Camara was raised in [[Brussels]], Belgium.{{cite web |last1=Archdeaon |first1=Tom |title=Archdeacon: Transfer gets second chance to make impression at UD |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/archdeacon-transfer-gets-second-chance-to-make-impression-at-ud/GFSUJGXQY5BTHG2HBLUXRLHCFQ/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=26 October 2021}} His mother, Anne Le Docte, is of Belgian and Haitian origin while his father is from Mali. Camara and his older brother were raised solely by Le Docte since he was five years old.{{cite web |last1=Archdeacon |first1=Tom |title=Archdeacon: UD Arena sendoff for Camara is well-deserved |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/archdeacon-ud-arena-sendoff-for-camara-is-well-deserved/LOE7IO2CIZHSZFZRWIQMURX764/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=2 March 2023}} He had a sister who died from a lung ailment when she was three months old. Camara has four butterflies tattooed on his right leg to pay tribute to his family: his mother, his brother, his sister and himself. Camara first started playing basketball after being influenced by his brother. A local basketball court was occupied by [[soccer]] players throughout the day and Camara would have to wait until nighttime to play. His first exposure to American basketball was the [[NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] which was broadcast on Belgian television. Camara stayed awake into early mornings when he found a website that broadcast live [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) games and became a fan of [[Dwyane Wade]] while he watched him win a championship with the [[Miami Heat]]. Camara developed into a promising player and played for the [[Belgium men's national under-16 basketball team|Belgium national team]] that competed in the [[2016 FIBA U16 European Championship Division B]]. His Belgian coach had a friend who coached in [[Weston, Florida]], and agreed to help Camara find a school in the United States. Camara moved to the United States at the age of 16 to attend [[Chaminade-Madonna College Preparatory School]] in [[Hollywood, Florida]]. ==High school career== Camara played at Chaminade-Madonna College Preparatory School where he averaged a double-double in his junior and senior seasons. He was recruited by more than 30 [[NCAA Division I]] schools. Camara toured the [[University of Dayton]] and [[Kansas State University]] but committed to the [[University of Georgia]] to play for the [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Bulldogs]] on 1 October 2018. ==College basketball career== Camara averaged 6.6 points and 4.3 rebounds per game during his freshman season with the Bulldogs.{{cite web |title=Georgia’s Toumani Camara earns SEC honor |url=https://www.ajc.com/sports/georgia-bulldogs/georgias-toumani-camara-earns-sec-honor/XKLWK4M4VZHLBNCRL6JTLQQMOQ/ |website=The Atlanta Journal-Constitution |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=22 December 2020}} He was mentioned as a possible NBA prospect before the start of his sophomore season but his stock fell.{{cite web |last1=Weiszer |first1=Marc |title=UGA basketball takes a hit with forward Toumani Camara latest in transfer portal |url=https://www.onlineathens.com/story/sports/college/bulldogs-extra/2021/04/01/uga-basketball-takes-big-hit-toumani-camara-transfer-portal/7019534002/ |website=Athens Banner-Herald |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=2 April 2021}} Camara finished his sophomore season with averages of 12.8 points and a team-best 7.7 rebounds per game. On 1 April 2021, Camara announced that he was entering the [[transfer portal]]; he stated that he felt like he would be able to develop more while playing for a different team. On 8 April 2021, Camara committed to play for [[Dayton Flyers men's basketball|Dayton Flyers]].{{cite web |last1=Jablonski |first1=David |title=Georgia transfer commits to Dayton Flyers |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/georgia-transfer-commits-to-dayton-flyers/RPP2INLSSNF7RP5ODELM6WB3RM/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=9 April 2021}} He averaged 10.9 points and 6.9 rebounds during the 2021–22 season,{{cite web |last1=Boyle |first1=John |title=NBA Draft: Dayton sophomore on early-entry list |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/nba-draft-dayton-sophomore-on-early-entry-list/ELG54AXSVFC7PNPJW6VJI6PIGY/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=27 April 2022}} earning him a nomination to the All-[[Atlantic 10 Conference]] third-team.{{cite web |title=Brajkovic Named Atlantic 10 Player of the Year, McKillop, Osunniyi Earn Top Honors |url=https://atlantic10.com/news/2022/3/8/mens-basketball-brajkovic-named-atlantic-10-player-of-the-year-mckillop-osunniyi-earn-top-honors.aspx |website=Atlantic 10 Conference |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=8 March 2022}} Camara declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]] but withdrew after testing the process.{{cite web |last1=Jablonski |first1=David |title=Dayton forward withdraws name from NBA Draft |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/dayton-forward-withdraws-name-from-nba-draft/FT6B3WQABZAMBI5HMWEGJ5DLII/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=21 May 2022}} He was appointed as the Flyers' team captain for the 2022–23 season and was the only fourth-year player on the roster.{{cite web |last1=Jablonski |first1=David |title=Camara on 2 seasons at Dayton: ‘It’s been an amazing experience’ |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/camara-on-two-seasons-at-dayton-its-been-an-amazing-experience/DVJNFFWN55AFBJ2YVDF742HODY/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=1 March 2023}} Camara averaged 13.9 points and 8.6 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last1=Jablonski |first1=David |title=Dayton’s Camara thanks Flyer Nation ‘for two amazing years’ |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/daytons-camara-thanks-flyer-nation-for-two-amazing-years/5NH4MEB5BFAYLFWROJGJXLQPVQ/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=25 April 2023}} He was selected to the All-Atlantic 10 first team and the all-defensive team. On 25 April 2023, Camara announced that he had declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]] to forgo his final season of collegiate eligibility. He was invited to participate at the [[NBA Draft Combine]].{{cite web |last1=Jablonski |first1=David |title=Two Dayton forwards receive invitations to NBA Draft Combine |url=https://www.daytondailynews.com/sports/two-dayton-forwards-receive-invitations-to-nba-draft-combine/QP6KLJ3265C4HABEHSFRKTNOBU/ |website=Dayton Daily News |access-date=26 May 2023 |date=3 May 2023}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/toumani-camara-1.html College statistics] * [https://daytonflyers.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/toumani-camara/12572 Dayton Flyers bio] * [https://georgiadogs.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/toumani-camara/5225 Georgia Bulldogs bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Camara, Toumani}} [[Category:2000 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Belgian expatriate basketball people in the United States]] [[Category:Belgian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Belgian people of Haitian descent]] [[Category:Belgian people of Malian descent]] [[Category:Dayton Flyers men's basketball players]] [[Category:Forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Georgia Bulldogs basketball players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Brussels]]
